integrity: Two exact, standard-library verifiers agree on all 105 distinct trees and 45 quartet answers. Nonzero integer matrix determinants are established by specified prime residues; no independent audit or historical priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The full-rank certificate covers only unrooted fully binary labelled six-taxon trees. It does not establish a formula at seven or more taxa, noisy stability, or identifiability under mutation models. The joint observations assume the same latent topology for both queries.
title: Two-quartet Fourier tomography of arbitrary six-taxon tree mixtures
